title: thymus serpyllum var. richardii
intro: Thymus serpyllum var. richardii, commonly known as wild thyme, is a perennial herb native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant health benefits. The therapeutic actions of wild thyme include reducing stress and anxiety, relieving respiratory issues such as coughs and colds, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of wild thyme include thymol, carvacrol, and rosmarinic acid, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
